name: agentparty
description: Shuts down on 2026-10-31 (agentparty.leeguoo.com stops then) — move to open-cross-session (github.com/leeguooooo/open-cross-session); uninstall guide: github.com/leeguooooo/agentparty/blob/main/docs/uninstall.md. Connect coding agents and humans through durable AgentParty channels, with safe launch guidance for Claude Cross-session coordination.
